# liquid-glass-studio renderer

- Upstream: https://github.com/iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio
- Commit: `d13c3e53813ebc1d8b52d878071b63212a550ebc`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

This directory vendors the upstream four-pass WebGL2/WebGPU renderer and shaders. The surrounding React adapter is project code and deliberately excludes the Studio editor UI and its MUI/Leva dependencies.
